frequency_question: How often do executive-backed fiscal harmonization proposals get approved by the coordinating council within a two-year window?
membership_rule: Includes all formal tax rate or structure harmonization proposals brought to a vote by the federal-state council with backing from the central fiscal authority and supporting state consensus; excludes proposals dropped prior to formal agenda placement due to lack of executive will.

cases.name: Initial GST rate structure rollout and slabs
Correction of inverted duty structure on textiles/footwear
Levy of 28% GST on online gaming, casinos, and horse racing
Exemption rationalization for unpackaged food grains
GST rate reduction on COVID-19 relief supplies
Rate rationalization on electric vehicle chargers

coverage_note: 8 major substantive tax/rate adjustment items brought forward by the executive consensus in the primary fiscal council; all passed successfully once tabled with executive intent.
known_gaps: Minor procedural deferrals that were later incorporated into subsequent meetings are treated as part of the continuous agenda rather than distinct failures.
validity_reason: The institutional voting structure and majority dynamics of the fiscal council remain stable under current constitutional provisions.
